messages.text: BL-1664 🎵 in progress — test_merge_deletion_guard.sh installs the real commit-msg chain into its fixture and then makes its own setup commits through it, so BL-1617's ambiguous-subject guard (landed 2026-09-18) refuses case 09's setup commit 'revert BL-0003/BL-0004 bounce' and the shell lane has been red since: the four hook-installing fixtures make setup commits with the chain off and only the commits under test run it, case 09 leads with BL-0003, and this file's twenty echo-into-grep -q assertions stop dying of SIGPIPE under pipefail
